item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 29/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The tropical cyclone over the central and northern parts of the South China Sea will move across the seas south of Hainan Island and towards the vicinity of central and northern Vietnam today and tomorrow, it will bring showers and thunderstorms to the western coast of southern China. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be showers over the coast of Guangdong early next week. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will be mainly fine and very hot during the day over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week, while thundery showers triggered by high temperatures will affect inland areas.
